Name: Demas
Summary: Demas was a fellowlabourer named in Colossians and Philemon, but in 2 Timothy Paul writes that Demas forsook him, having loved this present world, and departed to Thessalonica.
KeyStory: Demas was a fellowlabourer named in Colossians and Philemon, but in 2 Timothy Paul writes that Demas forsook him, having loved this present world, and departed to Thessalonica.
LifeLesson: Love for this present world can undo years of labour beside the gospel; the warning stands.
